title: Digital Icons
slide_intent: Carry a familiar symbol style into small interface controls so people can recognize actions across physical and digital encounters.
strategic_value: Brown illustration-derived icons and matching size colors can connect Burger King’s website and app with its packaging vocabulary.
demonstration: A cream page pairs digital icon guidance with two rows of labeled action symbols and a lower row of red S, orange M and brown L circles.
practical_value: Use the digital icon family at no more than 20 × 20 px, keeping BBQ Brown as the default and preserving size-color exceptions.

content_islands.name: Digital rules
content_islands.spec: Place the style rationale, maximum pixel dimensions and color exceptions in the left column.

content_islands.name: Action icons
content_islands.spec: Arrange captioned pickup, dining, takeout, ordering, profile and other interface symbols in two rows.

content_islands.name: Size markers
content_islands.spec: Show Small, Medium and Large circles below the action grid, labeled S, M and L.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links the illustration-inspired shapes to simplicity and immediate identification.
reference_purposes.Expression: The digital symbols use bold brown silhouettes and three colored size markers.
reference_purposes.Application: The page specifies use in websites and phone apps and maps package size colors into digital icons.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Digital icons are no larger than 20 × 20 px; default is BBQ Brown, with Small Fiery Red, Medium Flaming Orange, Large BBQ Brown and Value no color.

ingredient.name: Digital icons
ingredient.role: Make small interface actions recognizable within the brand.
ingredient.application: Keep icons at or below 20 × 20 px. Use BBQ Brown except size markers: Small Fiery Red, Medium Flaming Orange, Large BBQ Brown; Value has no color.
ingredient.scope: Historical website and phone-app guidance; distinct from operational packaging icon sizes in points.
